measures.title: Library district parcel tax
measures.summary: A ten-year parcel tax to fund library hours and facilities.
measures.yes_means: Property owners pay an added annual parcel tax; libraries expand hours and repair facilities.
measures.no_means: No new tax; library hours and repairs depend on existing funding.
measures.fiscal: Estimated to raise about $2 million per year (sample figure from the county analysis).
measures.funding: Yes campaign: mostly local donors. No campaign: small, mostly self-funded (sample).

by_issue.note: Funds after-school programs.
New tax, but with a fixed term and annual audit.

measures.reasoning: The measure aligns with your education interest; the fixed term and audit reduce the fiscal concern.
measures.caveats: Check how the tax applies to your property type.

measures.title: Term limits change
measures.summary: Changes the term limits for state legislators.
measures.yes_means: Legislators may serve longer under a revised cap.
measures.no_means: Current term limits stay in place.
measures.legal_status: Litigation pending; verify the measure is still on the ballot.

by_issue.note: Arguments cut both ways; evidence is mixed.

measures.reasoning: Your stated priorities do not clearly point either way.
measures.caveats: Read the official analysis before deciding.

measures.reasoning: The official performance evaluation was positive and no documented concerns were found; none of your priorities map to this office.
